description: 12 multi-feature / underspecified prompts for the vague-request rubric (issue 385).

prompts.title: Ambiguous delete
expectedSubFeatures: list or confirm target items before deleting

prompts.title: Shop with ores and food
prompts.prompt: In pack bench, build a /shop menu selling minecraft:iron_ingot for 25 coins, minecraft:diamond for 200 coins, and minecraft:cooked_beef for 10 coins.

prompts.title: Starter and daily kit menu
prompts.prompt: In pack bench, create a /kits menu with a one-time Starter kit (minecraft:stone_sword and 8 minecraft:bread) and a 24h Daily kit (minecraft:golden_apple) that tells the player to come back later if on cooldown.

prompts.title: Zombie hunter quest
prompts.prompt: In pack bench, build a Zombie Hunter quest (kill 10 zombies for 100 coins, tracked in /quests) plus a 5% Rotten Heart (ROTTEN_FLESH) custom item drop on zombie kills.

prompts.title: Mystery crate with key
prompts.prompt: In pack bench, create a Mystery Crate furniture (model models/crate.json) and a Crate Key item (TRIPWIRE_HOOK); right-clicking the crate with a key consumes it and gives weighted rewards (70% 8 iron_ingot, 25% 2 diamond, 5% 1 nether_star announced in broadcast).

prompts.title: Ruby sword forge
prompts.prompt: In pack bench, create a /forge GUI with durable input slots where placing sample:ruby_sword in slot 11 and 3 sample:ruby in slot 13 and paying 200 coins crafts a new refined_ruby_sword (NETHERITE_SWORD).

prompts.title: Lifesteal dash sword (partial gap)
prompts.prompt: In pack bench, make an RPG lifesteal dash sword with a 5s right-click dash and lifesteal on hit.

prompts.title: /pay and /top leaderboard (partial gap)
prompts.prompt: In pack bench, add a /pay command and a /top richest or top kills menu.

prompts.title: Mana bar HUD + fireball wand (partial gap)
prompts.prompt: In pack bench, show a mana bar HUD that regenerates every second and powers a fireball wand.
